Restore this vault on a machine that never held it.

USAGE
  sennit hydrate [flags]

FLAGS
  --depth level    How far to go: catalog (locate records), metadata (hold and
                   file them), index (search by meaning) (default metadata)
  --quiet          Report only the summary, not each record

VAULT FLAGS
  --home dir       Vault directory (default ~/.sennit)
  --indexer url    Indexer URL (default https://sia.storage)
  --offline        Work from this device only, without contacting the indexer

OUTPUT FLAGS
  --color when     When to colour output: auto, always or never (default auto)
  --verbose        Show timings, read tiers and other detail

EXAMPLES
  $ sennit hydrate
  $ sennit hydrate --depth index
